text: great so the next thing is so in that asset explorer right you click a chevron on the item or just the item in general and it expands and shows 4 folders but clicking any one of them doesnt do jack shit so its time to retire that behavior entirely
resolution: Retired the model-package subfolder behavior end to end. Model rows in the asset tree are now terminal model assets with no chevron expansion and no generated mesh/atlases/paints/shaders children. Deleted the corresponding special file-grid navigation, subfolder classification, file-list resolution, and count paths; the actual package directories remain untouched as storage internals. Added a hot-state migration from old model-…/<subdir> selections back to the owning model node and pinned it in panel-system tests. ReleaseFast editor ship passes.
